premise: I drained my $110,000 IRA to back my brother’s high‑end dog‑training kennel, notarizing a 45% ownership share and a promise to board my aging lab free, but he forged a deed, sold the kennel to a vet chain for $680,000, and sent me a $12,000 check; I dug up our original agreement from our mother’s attic, proved the forgery via ink analysis, and voided the sale, so now I own ‘Karma Kennels’ and my brother is court‑ordered to clean runs wearing a vest that reads ‘I Stole My Sister’s Retirement’ while every adoption brochure shows his mugshot.
